scope: Serial warmed CPU trials. Screening: 48 fixed self-play seeds; confirmation: same first 25 seeds, every worker warmed. Update: exact saved round-40 rollout, pre-update checkpoint/Adam/RNG restored. Original checkpoints unchanged.
caveats: Screening warms one game per configured worker; confirmation also verifies every worker PID completed warm-up.
Model and gradient graphs were warmed; update timing includes snapshot overhead (including its first trace, less than 0.14 seconds).
CPU cores are process CPU seconds / wall seconds for the benchmark, not whole-machine utilization.
Replicates show timing variation; this is one machine and checkpoint, not a new full learning run.
Game feature/action hashes exclude recurrent memory and behavior probabilities; altered intra-operation threading can change floating-point training results slightly.
